03-pelican.name: Halcyon
03-pelican.pitch: Mid-century paperback method (Tschichold's bands, Marber's grid, Facetti's abstract science covers) without the pastiche. Every cover has the same three bands: title on paper, a black level strip, and a flat colour field holding one abstract emblem of the book's mechanism. Field colour is the level (yellow, green, ultramarine), and signal red marks the idea.

06-letterform.name: Codepoint
06-letterform.pitch: One book, one character. Each title gets a single glyph from its own subject (∂ for the maths, σ for neural networks, ≈ for context compaction, QKᵀ for transformers), set monumental and cropped above a fixed rule, with the title hung below like a type-specimen caption. Level is how much ink the cover carries: bare paper, ultramarine, then black.
